GOOD SUPPER. NOW THE PROMISES. EACH CARD GOES TO
THE PERSON NAMED ON IT.
I WAS HOPING THE FOOD MIGHT SPEAK FOR ITSELF.
IT DID. IT MADE NO OFFER TO WASH UP.
JACKIE TREE: COOKING AND KITCHEN CLEANUP.
JACKIE TREE PLEDGE

I'LL COOK AND CLEAN THE KITCHEN. EVEN THE PANS I
CAN HIDE INSIDE LARGER PANS.

MY CARD IS COOKING AND CLEANUP. THIS ONE BELONGS
TO THE NAME AT THE TOP.

BUNNY EASTER: ACCURATE INVITATIONS AND THE AGREED
GUEST COUNT.
BUNNY EASTER PLEDGE

ACCURATE INVITATIONS AND THE AGREED GUEST COUNT.
I'LL INVITE THEM TO THE EVENING WE'RE ACTUALLY
HAVING. HOW NOVEL.

INVITATIONS AND GUEST COUNT. THAT'S MINE. I KNOW
EVERYBODY; IT DOESN'T MEAN I'VE OFFERED TO DO
EVERYTHING.

FRANKIE MAPLEWOOD: THE SHARED PLAN AND WRITTEN
TERMS.
FRANKIE MAPLEWOOD PLEDGE

THE SHARED PLAN AND WRITTEN TERMS. I'LL WRITE DOWN
THE JOBS. "BUT IT'S IN YOUR HANDWRITING" WILL NOT
MAKE IT MY WASHING-UP.

THE SHARED PLAN AND WRITTEN TERMS ARE MINE. THIS
CARD BELONGS TO THE NAME AT THE TOP.

MILO PENNANT: LOANED SOUND EQUIPMENT AND THE
AGREED VOLUME.
MILO PENNANT PLEDGE

MY SOUND EQUIPMENT, AT THE AGREED VOLUME. GOOD
LORD. I'VE FINISHED TALKING AND I'M STILL HERE.

SOUND EQUIPMENT AND THE AGREED VOLUME. THAT'S MY
CARD. I'M TRYING TO MAKE A SMALLER PROMISE; DON'T
DISTRACT ME.

VIVIAN VOSS: TONIGHT'S STYLING AND A LATER
CONVERSATION ABOUT POSSIBLE WORK. NO GUARANTEED
BOOKING.
VIVIAN VOSS PLEDGE

TONIGHT'S STYLING, AND A LATER CONVERSATION. NO
GUARANTEED BOOKING. THERE. EVEN MY SMALL PRINT
LOOKS GOOD.

TONIGHT'S STYLING, THEN A CONVERSATION ABOUT
POSSIBLE WORK. NO BOOKING PROMISED. I'M NOT
AVAILABLE BY THE PARAGRAPH.

RITA STRINGER: CERAMIC SERVICE AND DISPLAY,
CREDITED TO RITA STRINGER.
RITA STRINGER PLEDGE

MY CERAMIC SERVICE AND DISPLAY, CREDITED TO RITA
STRINGER. THAT'S MINE. I'VE PRACTISED THE MODEST
LITTLE NOD.

CERAMIC SERVICE AND DISPLAY. RITA STRINGER. MY
NAME'S ON THE PLATES; THERE'S NO NEED TO LOOK AT
MY HUSBAND.

FELIX BUNT: THE TESTED GATE AND THE AGREED
SCHEDULED REPAIR WORK.
FELIX BUNT PLEDGE

THE TESTED GATE AND THE AGREED SCHEDULED REPAIR
WORK. I'D MAKE A SPEECH, BUT YOU'VE SEEN THE GATE.

THE TESTED GATE AND THE SCHEDULED REPAIR WORK.
THOSE ARE MY JOBS. I'M WEARING A TOOL BELT, NOT A
CHAIN OF OFFICE.

MR. STRINGER: RENEWAL COMMITMENT AND FUNDING AND
SCHEDULING THE AGREED REPAIR.
MR. STRINGER PLEDGE

RENEWAL, AND I FUND AND SCHEDULE THE AGREED
REPAIR. YES, BOTH. FRANKIE IS LOOKING AT THE GAP
AFTER "AND."

RENEWAL, REPAIR FUNDING AND SCHEDULING. THAT'S MY
CARD. I CAN EXPRESS A VIEW ON THE COOKING, BUT
APPARENTLY THAT ISN'T A CONTRIBUTION.

APPROVED, AND PINNED UNDER THE RIGHT NAME. NO ONE
HAS ACCIDENTALLY ACQUIRED A SPOUSE.

ASK THE PERSON NAMED ON IT FIRST. BEING LEGIBLE
ISN'T THE SAME AS AGREEING.
TO THE PEOPLE WHO MADE ROOM FOR EACH OTHER.

I THOUGHT KEEPING EVERYONE HAPPY MEANT SAYING YES
TO EVERYTHING. THANK YOU FOR HELPING ME DO THE
THINGS I ACTUALLY PROMISED. TO OUR HOME, AND
EVERYONE WHO HELPED US MAKE ROOM.
TO PROMISES WITH NAMES ON THEM.

TO EIGHT PEOPLE WHO CAME FOR THREE DIFFERENT
EVENINGS AND STAYED FOR THE SAME ONE. THANK YOU.
NEXT TIME I'LL ASK YOU BEFORE SAYING YOU'D BE
DELIGHTED.

WILL YOU SIGN THE RENEWAL AND REPAIR TERMS WE
DISCUSSED?

CARE FOR THE HOUSE. THE AGREED GUESTS AND NOISE.
RENEWAL CONFIRMED, AND THE PROMISED REPAIR FUNDED
AND SCHEDULED.

THOSE ARE THE STANDARDS FOR THE HOUSEHOLD. OUR
PRIVATE RELATIONSHIPS ARE OUR OWN.
YES. I'LL JUDGE HOW YOU LOOK AFTER THE PLACE.
GOOD. NO BOX FOR "WHO'S KISSING WHOM." I CHECKED.
I GATHERED.

IT NEEDS HIS AGREEMENT AND HIS SIGNATURE. WE'VE
SPENT THE EVENING GETTING THE WORDS RIGHT. I'M NOT
BORROWING HIS NAME NOW.

SIGNED AND PINNED. RENEWAL, AND THE AGREED REPAIR.
I CAN STOP WONDERING WHAT HIS SMILE MEANS.

I'LL ADD THE REPAIR DATE WE AGREED. THEN I'M
READING THE WHOLE CARD BACK. WE'RE LEAVING NOTHING
CROPPED.
THERE. YOUR PENCIL. OUR COPY. KEEP BOTH.

WE'LL TALK ABOUT POSSIBLE WORK ANOTHER DAY.
TONIGHT YOU DELIVERED THE SUPPER. I'VE MET
PRODUCERS WHO COULDN'T MANAGE LUNCH.

ANOTHER CONVERSATION, ANOTHER DAY. I'D LIKE TO SEE
WHAT YOU'RE LIKE WHEN YOU AREN'T PREVENTING THREE
THINGS FROM FALLING OVER.

I'D LIKE THAT OTHER CONVERSATION. WE CAN DECIDE
WHAT TO CALL IT WHEN YOU AREN'T HOLDING A TRAY
BETWEEN US.
RITA GOT THE HOUSE RIGHT.
OUR DOORS AREN'T THOSE COLORS.
NOT THE DOORS. US.
THERE'S ENOUGH ROOM AT THE TABLE.
THERE IS.
MUTUAL BENEFIT SUPPER. I'VE KEPT IT VERY SIMPLE.

PUT "IT'S A MEAL" UNDERNEATH. IN VERY LARGE
LETTERS.
MUTUAL BENEFIT SUPPER
REVISIT THE EVENING BEFORE THE FINALE

MATCH EACH PROMISE TO THE PERSON WHO ACTUALLY MADE
IT.

THE NOTEBOOK AND PORTRAIT CARDS PAIR EVERY NAME
WITH A PRACTICAL RESPONSIBILITY. STRINGER'S
UNSIGNED TERMS CARD IS STILL YOURS TO GIVE HIM.

GET THE SEVEN OTHER NAMED CARDS APPROVED, CONFIRM
JACKIE'S COOKING-AND-CLEANUP CARD, AND PIN ALL
EIGHT. GIVE STRINGER THE AGREED RENEWAL AND REPAIR

CARD TO SIGN. FINALLY, GIVE FRANKIE THE GREASE
PENCIL TO RECORD AND READ BACK THE AGREED DATE.

ALL FOUR CONTESTS WON. THE FINAL COMMITMENTS CAN
BEGIN.
Come and Knock on Our Door
